B0700.title: Sunroof Open/Close Circuit
B0700.description: A fault has been detected in the sunroof open/close motor circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0710.title: Sunroof Position Sensor Circuit
B0710.description: A fault is detected in the sunroof position sensor circuit; one-touch and pinch protection may not function.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
